calls.video_title: A Once in a 100 Year Investment Opportunity Just Started (Felix Nikolas Prehn on Where He's Buying)
calls.thesis: BUY — first tracked MarketBeat gold call (guest Felix Nikolas Prehn). Gold is a 10+ year safety play: gold doesn't go up, the dollar goes down; the Fed is printing at astounding rates, so gold protects against inflation.
calls.base_case: Long-horizon inflation hedge; money printing lifts gold over time.
calls.bull_case: Dollar debasement accelerates and gold re-rates well above $4,000.
calls.bear_case: War lifts oil/inflation expectations and rates, making bonds more attractive and pressuring gold; Middle East sellers add supply.
